# Fishing Companion SDK

> C++17 Dear ImGui / DirectX 11 overlay SDK shell for safe UI modules, HUD panels, timers, and allowed data integrations.

## Start Here

- [SDK Overview](docs/SDK_OVERVIEW.md): What the SDK is, repository map, public headers, runtime flow.
- [Quickstart](docs/QUICKSTART.md): Minimal module that registers a tab.
- [API Reference](docs/API_REFERENCE.md): C ABI, C++ wrappers, versioning, tab registration.
- [UI Guide](docs/UI_GUIDE.md): Visual rules and SDK UI helpers.
- [Module Lifecycle](docs/MODULE_LIFECYCLE.md): Loading from `mods/*.dll`, success/failure behavior, shutdown.
- [AI Context](docs/AI_CONTEXT.md): Repo-specific instructions for coding agents.

## Key Source Files

- [FCSDK.h](src/SDK/FCSDK.h): Public SDK ABI.
- [FCSDK_UI.h](src/SDK/FCSDK_UI.h): Public UI helper layer.
- [ModuleLoader.cpp](src/SDK/ModuleLoader.cpp): Runtime module loader.
- [Menu.cpp](src/GUI/Menu.cpp): Main shell UI and navigation.
- [Theme.cpp](src/GUI/Theme.cpp): ImGui theme.
- [Overlay.cpp](src/Core/Overlay.cpp): DX11 lifecycle, cursor handling, module loading.
- [ExampleMod.cpp](examples/ExampleMod.cpp): Minimal external module.

## Safety Scope

Use this SDK for UI modules, HUD widgets, settings, timers, and allowed telemetry/log/save-file integrations. Do not add anti-cheat bypasses, stealth mechanisms, unauthorized memory access, or multiplayer advantage automation.

## ImGui Module Note

External DLL modules that compile their own Dear ImGui code must set the host context before drawing: `ImGui::SetCurrentContext((ImGuiContext*)FCSDK_GetImGuiContext())`. Keep the module Dear ImGui version aligned with `FCSDK_GetImGuiVersion()`.
